verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a public GraphQL API with named mutations for issuing financial accounts and cards, setting spend rules and velocity controls, and managing webhooks and signing keys. It also offers an interactive code explorer, a production-like test environment, an official typed Node.js SDK (beta), and an llms.txt for AI consumption. The missing OpenAPI file is expected for a GraphQL API and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end.
